userStories.title: Add a parity test asserting the clause in the 3 embedded shipped copies
userStories.description: As a cam maintainer, I need a parity test (CAM-49/68/79 class) that asserts the merit-over-cost clause is present in the embedded shipped copies of all 3 artifacts, so that a future edit that drops the clause or forgets to regenerate the embed fails CI.
acceptanceCriteria: test/embedded.test.ts contains a new describe block that reads the embedded shipped copies via templatesContents['skills/grill-with-docs/SKILL.md'], templatesContents['commands/cam-plan.md'], and templatesContents['agents/subagent-orchestrator.md'] and asserts each toContain the clause marker ('engineering merit'). [oracle: file-assert grep -q "templatesContents\['skills/grill-with-docs/SKILL.md'\]" test/embedded.test.ts]
The new tests pass against the embed produced in US-001. [oracle: named-command bun test test/embedded.test.ts]
The test would FAIL if any of the 3 embedded copies lacked the clause (assertion targets the embedded copy, not the source .md on disk). [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
Vendor drift check passes. [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
Full gate suite passes. [oracle: bun run check:all]
Typecheck passes. [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint passes. [oracle: bun run lint]
Tests pass. [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Add to test/embedded.test.ts (follow the existing 'oracle contract in planner prompt (US-001)' / 'oracle enforcement in auditor prompt (US-002)' describe blocks at lines 120-160 as the template). Assert against the EMBEDDED copies via `templatesContents[key]` (imported from ../src/templates/embedded.ts), NOT against files read from disk: the whole point is to catch a stale _generated.ts. Keys: 'skills/grill-with-docs/SKILL.md', 'commands/cam-plan.md', 'agents/subagent-orchestrator.md'. Use a stable substring of the clause ('engineering merit') as the marker so the test survives light wording edits. This is a test-authoring story, not a behavior change; check:all is the top-level gate (runs typecheck, test, embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity).
